% test-xformnum's name of a form used as a number, with hyperref loaded:
% assigned to a count register, after \ifnum, in the text, and in a
% heading that goes to the table of contents, and the name of a form made
% in the preamble. hyperref writes the heading to its bookmarks too, which
% the page does not show: the build stops there if the name is not a
% number. In the PDF the preamble's form is 1 and the body's 2.
\pdfoutput=1
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{hyperref}
\setbox0\hbox{logo}\immediate\pdfxform0 \edef\logoform{\the\pdflastxform}
\begin{document}
\tableofcontents

\setbox2\hbox{x}\pdfxform2

\section{Head \pdfxformname\pdflastxform{} end}

\makeatletter
\count@=\pdfxformname\pdflastxform\relax
Count: [\the\count@] end.
\makeatother

Ifnum: [\ifnum\pdfxformname\pdflastxform>0 pos\else zero\fi] end.

Text: [\pdfxformname\pdflastxform] end.

Preamble: [\pdfxformname\logoform] end.
\end{document}
